title: Making the components of the generic fibre geometrically irreducible by a finite etale base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Over an irreducible base and for a finite type morphism, the lemma constructs a finite etale covering of a nonempty open such that all irreducible components of the generic fibre of the base-changed morphism are geometrically irreducible, with the covering source affine and irreducible. The proof passes to a finite etale cover separating the components, analyses the generic fibre component by component, and then extracts a further finite etale piece over which each surviving component becomes geometrically irreducible. Tracking the components through two successive finite etale base changes is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 6795-6829.
